title: 第27章  我懒得听，你更不配讲
novel_title: 人在镇魔司，红词加身只杀不渡
content_zh:
赵衡别院。

    书房内。

    茶盘上那罐大红袍又泡了一遍，茶汤的颜色比之前更浅，但香气还在。

    桌上那本新人名录上，陆渊的名字在第一列，介绍只有寥寥几字。

    陆渊，习武五年，凡境二层，云安县忠烈之后，直升镇魔司。

    这是陆渊入门第一天，书吏老周亲笔所写。

    赵衡端起茶盏抿了一口，目光看向窗外。

    周通，初境三层，在镇魔卫里算是垫底的那一批，打不了硬仗也出不了大错。

    就像河滩上的石头，捡起一块扔出去，连个水花都溅不起来。

    可做人不是石头，要守规矩，知进退。

    若有人以为拳头硬就是本事，那他大概率是不懂的。

    一个刚入门的新人，敢打伤入册七年的镇魔卫，不管有理没理，至少这个新人是不懂规矩的。

    周通有错，可他有资历。

    陆渊就是再有理也只是个新人，他得懂事。

    赵衡目光看向墙上那柄铁扇，九根扇骨都是玄铁打造，每一根都刻满符文。

    合起来是一把短尺，钝拙无华。

    展开是一把铁扇，寒刃藏锋。

    他这人从不怕事，但向来不喜下面的人好勇斗狠。

    因为没必要。

    镇魔司的锋刃就该对着妖魔，不该对着自己人。

    虽说周通有错在先，陆渊出手情有可原。

    但情有可原是一回事，伤了人，就是另一回事。

    他不会因为这点小事就对陆渊打压针对，那不是他的风格。

    他想要的，是将这个年轻人收拢过来。

    不是打压，是收拢。

    但在收拢之前，该有的姿态要有，该立的规矩也要立。

    点到即止，让他知道今后不能再对同僚动手。

    赵衡在心里把要说的话过了一遍，看了一眼日头，想必人也快到了。

    他又看向茶盘，水还热着，茶也够。

    他把椅子摆正，那本新人名录收入抽屉，墙上的铁扇往中间挪了挪，显得居中工整。

    没过多久，耳边传来脚步声，一道人影走入院内。

    咚咚咚——

    敲门声响起。

    “进来。”

    赵衡抬头，看向门口，一个身穿皂衣的年轻人走了进来。
content_en:
Zhaoheng Courtyard.

    In the study room.

    The pot of Dahongpao on the tea tray was steeped again. The color of the tea soup was lighter than before, but the aroma was still there.

    In the newcomer's directory on the table, Lu Yuan's name was in the first column, and there were only a few words in the introduction.

    Lu Yuan, who has been practicing martial arts for five years, is on the second level of the mortal realm. After becoming a loyal lieutenant in Yun'an County, he was directly promoted to the Demon Suppressing Division.

    This was written by the scribe Lao Zhou on Lu Yuan's first day as a disciple.

    Zhao Heng picked up the tea cup and took a sip, looking out the window.

    Zhou Tong, who is on the third level of the first level, is considered the bottom group among the demon-suppressing guards. He can't fight a tough battle and can't make big mistakes.

    It's like a stone on the river beach. If you pick one up and throw it out, it won't even make a splash.

    But being a human being is not like a stone. You must abide by the rules and know how to advance and retreat.

    If someone thinks that having a hard fist is a skill, then he probably doesn't understand.

    A newcomer who has just entered the army dares to hurt the demon-suppressing guard who has been registered for seven years. Regardless of whether it is justified or not, at least this newcomer does not understand the rules.

    Zhou Tong was wrong, but he had the qualifications.

    No matter how reasonable Lu Yuan is, he is still just a newcomer, he must be sensible.

    Zhao Heng looked at the iron fan on the wall. The nine fan bones were made of black iron, and each one was engraved with runes.

    Taken together, it is a short ruler, dull and unpretentious.

    Unfolded, it is an iron fan with a cold edge and hidden edge.

    He is never afraid of getting into trouble, but he never likes those below him to be aggressive and aggressive.

    Because it's not necessary.

    The sword of the Demon Suppressing Division should be pointed at demons, not your own people.

    Although Zhou Tong made a mistake first, Lu Yuan's action was excusable.

    But extenuating circumstances are one thing, hurting someone is another.

    He would not suppress Lu Yuan because of such a trivial matter. That is not his style.

    What he wanted was to gather this young man over.

    It's not about suppressing, it's about constricting.

    But before gathering together, the posture should be in place and the rules should be established.

    Stop it once and let him know that he can't do anything to his colleagues in the future.

    Zhao Heng thought over what he was going to say in his mind, and glanced at the sun. He must have arrived soon.

    He looked at the tea tray again. The water was still hot and there was enough tea.

    He straightened the chair, put the newcomer's directory in the drawer, and moved the iron fan on the wall to the middle, making it appear neatly centered.

    Not long after, the sound of footsteps was heard, and a figure walked into the courtyard.

    Dong dong dong——

    There was a knock on the door.

    "Come in."

    Zhao Heng raised his head and looked at the door. A young man wearing soap clothes walked in.
title_en: Chapter 27 I’m too lazy to listen, and you’re not worthy to speak
